validation_scope: Generated repair; behavioral validation not run
summary: The XSS flow reads `data` from a properties file and writes it into the HTTP response with only a weak `replaceAll("(<script>)", "")`, which fails to neutralize other HTML/script injection vectors (attribute breakouts, event handlers, mixed-case or split tags, etc.). I replaced the inadequate filter with full HTML entity encoding of the untrusted value before it is written to the response writer, which closes the source-to-sink flow while still displaying the configured `data` value.
